title: Abbas Mujhko Chhor Ke
body:
Thame hue kamar ko ye shabbir ne kaha.
Abbas mujh ko chhor ke tu bhi chala gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sb qatal ho gaye mera koi nhi bacha
Abbas mujh ko chhor ke tu bhi chla gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
1)
Pahuche jari ki laash pe maqtal me jab hussain.
Zanu pe sar ko rakh ke ye karte the roke Bain.
Kis ke sahare ab me jiyunga bhala bata.
<<DIVIDER>>
2)
Ankho me teer teri laga hai mere diler.
Aa khoon saaf krdun me ankho se teri sher
Ghash kha rhe the kehte hue yeh shahe karabala.
<<DIVIDER>>
3)
Tha zalimo ke dil me aye Abbas tera dar.
Mujh par na koi uthti thi Abbas bad nazar
Uth kr ye dekh haste hain ab mujh pe Ashkiya’n.
<<DIVIDER>>
4)
Abbas tere jaane se zainab ka hai ye haal
Chadar ko apni dekh ke hoti hai wo nidhal
Kehti hai kis tarha se jiyungi me ba wafa.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Bali sakina krti hai khaime me intezar.
kya dun use jawab bata de ye ek baar.
mar jayegi sunegi ye jis waqt ghum zada.
<<DIVIDER>>
6)
Tukde jari ki laash ke sheh ne samet kar.
Rakhe the Ek chatai me thame hue jigar.
Bazu ko leke goud me kehte the barha’n.
<<DIVIDER>>
7)
Shane utha ke apne dilawar ke khaq se.
Dil se kabhi lagaye kabhi choomne lge.
Or bazuo se kehne lage ye shahe huda.
<<DIVIDER>>
8)
Johar bayan kese ho mola ka halezar.
‘Haider’ ‘Ali’ yeh kehte the Sheh Hoke Beqarar
Mere liye yeh dagh hai Bhai Boht bada
author: Mir Johar Shikarpuri
